data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Use Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using a Chart.js chart
Cost tracking is displayed with a Chart.js chart
Success rates are visualized using a Chart.js chart

features.title: Develop Real-Time Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for live metrics.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is shown using a line chart
Stage completion rates are displayed with a bar chart
Success rate trends are visualized using an area chart

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features
features.description: Highlight Artemis features such as cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Cost tracking feature is displayed with a chart
Sandboxing feature is explained with visual aids
Learning metrics are shown using a chart

features.title: Present Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Include real metrics from recent Artemis runs to demonstrate system effectiveness.
acceptance_criteria: Actual data from recent runs is included
Metrics are displayed in a clear and understandable format
Charts accurately reflect the real data

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single standalone HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis self-demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file
Chart.js is included and functional

features.title: Integrate Supervisor Across Stages
features.description: Demonstrate supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Supervisor integration is visualized with a pie chart
Chart accurately reflects integration data
Chart is interactive and provides additional insights on hover

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides with Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with user navigation controls for manual progression.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set time interval
Navigation controls allow users to manually progress slides
Users can pause and resume auto-advance

features.title: Display Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Show code quality metrics like TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: TDD compliance is visualized with a radar chart
SOLID principles are displayed on the radar chart
Chart is clear and easy to interpret

features.title: Design Professional Presentation Style
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth transitions into the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient background is applied consistently
Transitions between slides are smooth
Overall presentation has a professional appearance
